title: Aspire TG Replacement Fixed Coil Pods - 2 Pack
description: The Aspire Cyber G vape kit is a compact and stylish starter vape kit created for all day-long MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping. With its sleek, futuristic design revealing the advanced technology inside encased in a colourful, satin-smooth chassis, this kit is ideal for vapers who want an easy-to-use, low-maintenance device that also looks amazing. These replacement Aspire TG 2ml pods are compatible with the Aspire Cyber G pod kit and feature fixed coils with a mesh build that heats up quickly, allowing for faster vaporisation of e-liquid and improved flavour production. Refilling the pods is effortless too - remove the rubber stopper on the side to reveal the filling port and top up with your preferred e-liquid. For optimal results, we recommend pairing these pods with nic salt , 50/50 and classic High-PG e-liquids.
